templates.title: Notification templates
templates.subtitle: Bilingual message templates for every student touchpoint, across push, in-app, SMS, WhatsApp and email.
templates.matrixHint: Message type × channel. Green cells have an active template — click a cell to filter the table, or + to create one.
templates.duplicated: Template duplicated — opened the copy for editing

editor.subtitle: Write the English and Arabic versions, insert variables, and check the live preview before saving.
editor.activeHint: Inactive templates cannot be used by automated triggers or campaigns.
editor.contentHint: Click a variable to insert it at the cursor in the field you last focused.
editor.variablesHint: Variables are replaced with each student's data when the message is sent.
editor.smsNote: Arabic SMS uses UCS-2 encoding: 70 characters per segment (67 when split). Keep OTP and alert messages to a single segment to reduce cost.
editor.emptyBody: Your message preview will appear here.

campaign.title: Send campaign
campaign.subtitle: Build an audience, pick a channel and template, then send now or schedule for later.
campaign.audienceHint: Combine filters — the recipient count updates live. Locked accounts are always excluded.
campaign.inactiveDaysHint: Leave empty to include all students
campaign.name: Campaign name
campaign.noTemplateHint: Create a template for this channel first.
campaign.emailReach: {{count}} matching students have no email address and will be skipped.
campaign.futureOnly: Pick a date and time in the future.
campaign.optOutNote: Students who opted out of marketing messages are excluded automatically.
campaign.confirmBody: “{{name}}” will be delivered via {{channel}} to {{count}} students — {{when}}. This cannot be recalled once sent.
campaign.sentToast: Campaign sent to {{count}} students — delivery reports are arriving
campaign.cancelBody: The scheduled send will be stopped and the campaign moved back to drafts.
campaign.platformsHint: Target app users (iOS / Android push) and/or the website. Leave empty for all.
campaign.matchedOf: {{matched}} students match, {{reachable}} reachable on this channel
campaign.pushReach: {{count}} matching students have no registered app device and will be skipped.
campaign.noRecipients: No students can be reached with these filters on this channel.

log.title: Delivery log
log.subtitle: Per-message delivery status from every provider, with retries for failed sends.
